purpose: Isolated matched-terrain experiment; no production integration

accuracy.method: Fresh Python horizons and daily builder; shared DE440 ephemerides at Python fine-stack ground height. Model consistency, not measured ground truth.

browser.method: One fresh Chrome profile per case; cold application caches, OS cache unspecified; Fast 4G 165 ms, 1,012,500 bytes/s download, no CPU throttling; isolated page, not UI rendering; 365 days at ten-minute cadence.
browser.limitations: Single run per case. Unthrottled cases repeated after reference work completed. The first two Fast 4G cases overlapped the end of Python reference processing; network transfer dominates, but these are not statistically controlled latency measurements. No CPU throttle, worker or UI rendering benchmark.

illumination.method: Existing synthetic long-term visible-disc benchmark evaluated on fresh tiled horizons. Glaser 2018 published percentages; not annual dated centre visibility or surveyed ground truth.
